# Award changes
## On this page:
- [Modern Awards Review](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/about-us/workplace-laws/award-changes#modern-awards-review)
- [4 yearly reviews](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/about-us/workplace-laws/award-changes#4-yearly-reviews)

## Annual Wage Review
Every year, the Commission reviews the [National Minimum WageA pay rate that applies to employees not covered by an award or registered agreement. Certain award or agreement free employees may have different pay entitlements depending on whether they have a reduced work capacity because of disability, if they're under the age of 21 or if they are an apprentice or trainee.](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/taxonomy/term/404) and minimum rates of pay in modern awards to decide if they should be increased.

The AWR usually happens between March and June.

## 4 yearly reviews
Before 2018, the Commission was required to review all modern awards every 4 years. The 4 yearly review commenced on 1 January 2014. This review is now in its final stages.

The 4 yearly reviews have resulted in common changes across many awards and specific changes to individual awards.

For more information about the 4 yearly review process, visit the Commission’s [4 yearly review](https://www.fwc.gov.au/hearings-decisions/major-cases/4-yearly-review-modern-awards) page.
